data.consequence: a wall of static crosses west to east every 90s; anything under it is muted (turrets and beacons stop firing, drones and playbooks refuse) but never damaged; the run cannot secure unless 3 of the 4 relay sites carry a standing turret or beacon when the third front arrives

briefing.geography: The Relay Valley ridge chain with four surveyed relay grounds along its map-wide corridor; the claim is staked on the second ground, where the guns can stand with you.
goals: Build across the four relay sites on the ridge chain.
Watch the north, west, and east approaches.
rules: Relay Rush reuses Relay Valley ground.
Four surveyed sites mark the ridge chain.
You stake the second relay ground; the other three want a walk.
Waves enter from the north, west, and east.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.
